name: WNBA_R1A4_STATIC_VERSIONED_DATASET_CERTIFICATION_V1

source.custody_method: Exact release asset id + filename + size + SHA-256 pins; audit downloads by asset id and fails on changed frozen bytes.

final_evidence.workflow: WNBA R1A.4 Static Versioned Dataset Audit

2023_team_box.digest_provenance: First computed in outcome-blind R1A.4 run 33077182651, frozen before final run, then independently matched in final run 33077317864.

certified_capabilities: Pinned static fixture identity for the intended 2021-2025 cohort.
Pinned static game-level two-sided team-box structure for every audited game.
Canonical game_id joins from each audited team-box asset to schedule identity at 100%.
Pregame chronology/team identity fields can be projected without loading score/winner/linescore values.
The source can support a later prefix constructor that first excludes the target game and future games, then uses only prior finalized games under separately frozen rules.

advanced_asof.reason: The published ESPN game-level team_box assets do not contain off_rating, def_rating, net_rating, pace or possessions. The published WNBA Stats team_season_stats surface is season-level, and no dated historical snapshots were certified for 2021-2025. Production prefers advanced values when available, so a basic-boxscore estimate cannot be silently declared exact equivalence.

anti_leakage_closure: The R1A.4 empirical audit loaded only contract-allowlisted non-outcome columns.
Forbidden score/winner/linescore columns were visible only as Parquet schema names; their values were never projected into memory.
No target-game result, target participation, market price, injury inference or post-tip state was used to choose the source or decision.
No end-of-season advanced snapshot is authorized for backward historical substitution.
